name: paperishere
description: PaperIsHere Chrome Extension (Manifest V3). Extension loads with zero build steps; this package exists only for tests and syntax checks.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check page.js && node --check save.js && node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && ! grep -nE '\[[^]]*\]\(https?://' *.js && echo SYNTAX_OK
